start.title: Departure date
start.description: e.g. 2026-09-12. A rough date is fine.

travellers.title: Who's going?
travellers.description: e.g. '4', or 'two adults and a toddler'. Leave empty if you're not sure yet.

tools.name: set_trip
tools.description: Change the trip's details when the traveller gives new ones: the departure date, who is going, or the destination. Record their words; never choose a date for them.

start.description: The departure date they gave: YYYY-MM-DD when they named a day, otherwise their words ('next spring').

travellers.description: How many are going ('4'), or who ('two adults and a toddler').

tools.name: plan_day
tools.description: Set one day's plan in plain sentences, one per line: what the day is for, then a couple of alternatives, then the free time. Use the date (YYYY-MM-DD) once it is known, otherwise 'Day 1', 'Day 2', … Never write 'Anchor:' or 'Options:' labels.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or 'Day 1' when the dates are not set yet.

plan.description: The day in plain sentences, one per line.

tools.name: pack_add
tools.description: Add an item to the packing list.

tools.name: journal_entry
tools.description: Capture a trip moment — a line a day.

tools.name: trip_status
tools.description: Who is going, the countdown, days planned, and the packing state.
